verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no compliant invoice generation, and no passing of required VAT fields, registration numbers, or locale invoicing rules to an invoicing system. TaxJar is positioned as a US sales tax product for calculation, nexus tracking, and filing. A VAT-number validation endpoint exists in the Node client, but that is an adjacent check, not invoice compliance.

support.subject: As an ops user, invoices come out compliant where I sell — required VAT fields, registration numbers, and locale rules flow through to my invoicing system or are generated by the product itself
